notes:
Passed on the fake backend with python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware run and no hardware backend. The upstream package was not installed, imported or run: it is a legacy gym/mujoco-py environment with a host-specific absolute asset path (humanoid_deepmimic_env.py:7) and a broken extrahard import (envs/__init__.py:2). The card's second entry symbol HumanoidDeepMimicExtraHardEnv is not implemented; the extrahard module defines only the stub FooEnv (humanoid_deepmimic_extrahard_env.py:5-15), so this package implements the first confirmed entry point only. The fake is a reduced pure-Python stand-in, not MuJoCo: it returns a 9-number observation while the model's own observation concatenates qpos[2:] (16), qvel (17) and cfrc_ext (48) = 81 numbers (its step state_vector is 18 qpos + 17 qvel = 35); it has no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, cfrc_ext, rendering or snapshot/restore. Its action bound is the model's three-motor ctrlrange of -0.3 to 0.3 (humanoid_deepmimic.xml:7, :123-125), not the legacy gym action space; its timestep is 15 ms (frame_skip 5 at humanoid_deepmimic_env.py:7 times the model's 0.003 s at humanoid_deepmimic.xml:9). The sim backend (gymnasium.make) was not run. Warnings are the expected ones: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only sets the next reset's seed); four G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for action_space, observation_space, dt and reset, which come from the external gym MujocoEnv base the clone imports and which the AST cannot follow; and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer inputs (seed twice, ticks) and the simulator-unit action.values. There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
